create.title: Uniform weighted exact square-root resonance mass and even constant coefficient
create.statement_tex: For fixed integer k>=2 and b_n>=0, set A_d=sum_(s>=1)b_(d s^2) for squarefree d and S=sum_d A_d^2<infinity. The sum over all 2^k sign vectors and ordered n_j>=1 with sum_j epsilon_j sqrt(n_j)=0 of product_j b_(n_j) is at most 2^k B_k S^(k/2), where B_k counts set partitions of k labels with no singleton. The mixed bound is 2^k B_k product_j S_j^(1/2). If b_n<=C tau(n)n^(-3/4), then S<=C^2 zeta(3/2)^10. Exact-resonance tails with max n_j>U are bounded by k2^k B_k S_>U^(1/2) S^((k-1)/2), tending uniformly to zero under a common divisor envelope. For real coefficients |a_n|<=b_n the even cosine exact coefficient is nonnegative; its contribution against w(R/T)>=0 is <=T||w||_1 B_k S^(k/2). Identification with the full infinite moment additionally requires sum|a_n|<infinity. For a_n(T)=r_2(n)n^(-3/4)Psi(sqrt(n/T)), real Schwartz Psi with |Psi|<=1, this yields 0<=D_12(T)<=T||w||_1 B_12 4^12 zeta(3/2)^60. Only zero radical differences are estimated: no finite-window near-resonance, full twelfth-moment, M1/M2 or pointwise exponent estimate follows.
